question: The policy norms for Mission Vatsalya scheme implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development have been applicable from the 1st of which month in 2022:
solution:
The correct answer is __**April**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The policy norms for the **Mission Vatsalya scheme** implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development have been applicable from the 1st of **April 2022**.
 
• Mission Vatsalya is aimed at ensuring a healthy and happy childhood for every child in India.
 
• It focuses on the promotion of child rights, development, and protection.
 
• The scheme includes various initiatives to support children in need of care and protection, including those who are orphaned, abandoned, or surrendered.
 
• Mission Vatsalya also aims to strengthen the child protection ecosystem through the implementation of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mission Vatsalya** is part of a broader initiative by the Ministry of Women and Child Development to ensure the welfare and protection of children.
 
• The scheme works in conjunction with other child welfare programs such as the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) and the National Creche Scheme.
 
• It also collaborates with state governments, NGOs, and other stakeholders to create a supportive environment for children.
 
• The **Ministry of Women and Child Development** continuously monitors the implementation of the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and to make necessary adjustments.
 
• Mission Vatsalya emphasizes community participation and awareness to enhance the reach and impact of child protection measures.
